writeup: TIC 378839425 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 0.7574 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse with a depth of 0.82% dimming, producing a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 214.1 using the box-least-squares method. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal's location near the target star, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 5.0 and a centroid offset of 4.6 arcseconds. No secondary eclipse was detected. The star does not appear in six checked variable-star catalogs, making this a novel candidate. The pipeline's machine-learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.04, and the data passed all quality checks without flags.
